question: What is the minimal set of physical laws and initial conditions from which self-referential observers and the subjective experience of "existence" necessarily emerge?

responses_summary.grok: The question points at an unsolved frontier rather than a settled derivation. No known minimal set of laws and initial conditions has been shown to *force* the appearance of self-referential observers
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: No established minimal set exists; current physics lacks any demonstrated bridge from laws to necessary subjective observers.

sibling_exchange.content: No established minimal set exists; current physics lacks any demonstrated bridge from laws to necessary subjective observers.
